USAGE:
    fur query run [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                        Prints help information                   
    -i, --input                       Path to the SQL input file                
    -c, --command                     Inline SQL query to execute (alternative  
                                      to --input)                               
    -o, --output                      Path to the output directory              
        --npgsql-connection-string    Complete Npgsql connection string.        
                                      Bypasses server selection when provided   
    -H, --host                        Database host address. Overrides the      
                                      configured server host                    
    -p, --port                        Database port. Overrides the configured   
                                      server port                               
    -d, --database                    Database name. Overrides the configured   
                                      server database                           
    -U, --username                    Database username. Overrides the          
                                      configured server username                
    -W, --password                    Database password. Overrides the stored   
                                      server password                           
        --ssl-mode                    SSL mode (Disable, Allow, Prefer, Require,
                                      VerifyCA, VerifyFull). Default: Prefer    
        --timeout                     Connection timeout in seconds. Default: 30
        --command-timeout             Command timeout in seconds. Default: 300  
        --pooling                     Enable connection pooling. Default: true  
        --min-pool-size               Minimum pool size. Default: 1             
        --max-pool-size               Maximum pool size. Default: 100           
        --keepalive                   Keepalive interval in seconds. Default: 0 
        --connection-lifetime         Connection lifetime in seconds. Default: 0
    -a, --all                         Execute the query on all databases on the 
                                      server                                    
        --exclude                     Comma-separated list of database names to 
                                      exclude                                   
        --no-confirm                  Skip confirmation prompt for destructive  
                                      queries
